Rewards
Earn miles faster in the air and on the ground, enjoy flexible award options and take advantage of the various ways to use your miles — including flights, hotels, car rentals and more.
Earn miles on United
®
9 total miles per $1 spent on eligible United flights: 6x miles on the Primary Cardmember's fare from United as a MileagePlus member, plus 3x miles on entire United purchase with the United Explorer Card. Mileage earning differs for Basic Economy or base options tickets. Premier
®
members earn even more.
3 miles per $1 spent on all other eligible United
®
purchases
Earn miles on other purchases
2 miles per $1 spent on dining
2 miles per $1 spent on hotel stays when booked directly with the hotel
1 mile per $1 spent on all other purchases
Earn a 10,000-mile award flight discount each year
Earn a 10,000-mile award flight discount after spending $20,000 on purchases each calendar year with your United℠ Explorer Card.
,
Earn a $100 United
®
travel credit
Earn $100 in United
®
TravelBank cash after you spend $10,000 on purchases each calendar year with your United℠ Explorer Card. You can use United TravelBank cash toward future flights on United
®
or United Express
®
.
,
Earn up to 1,000 Premier
®
qualifying points (PQP)
You’ll earn 1 PQP for every $20 you spend on purchases with your Explorer Card, up to 1,000 PQP in a calendar year. This can be applied toward your Premier
®
status qualification.
Not a Cardmember?
Learn more
If you’re already a United Cardmember and would like to switch to this product, please call the Chase phone number on the back of your current card to see if you’re eligible.
Rewards
Redeem your miles for flights, car rentals or shopping at your favorite retailers.
Award travel on Star Alliance™
Use your miles to connect with more of the world. You can earn and use MileagePlus miles on United and on any of the other member airlines in the Star Alliance network. With over 18,000 daily departures serving more than 1,300 worldwide destinations, your award travel opportunities are virtually endless.

Travel Benefits
The benefits that come with being a United℠ Explorer Cardmember make it easier than ever to travel smart.
Free first checked bag — a savings of up to $200 per roundtrip
The primary Cardmember and one companion on the same reservation get their first standard checked bag free (up to $50 each way/person) on United-operated flights when the primary Cardmember includes their United MileagePlus
®
number in the reservation and purchases the tickets from United with their card (waived for flights within 90 days of account opening). For details visit
united.com/ChaseBag
Opens overlay
.
2 United Club one-time passes per year
After account opening and on each anniversary — over a $100 value per year. For an updated list of United Club locations and any temporary closures, please visit
united.com
Opens overlay
.
25% back on United
®
Inflight and Club premium drink purchases
You’ll get 25% back as a statement credit on purchases of food, beverages and Wi-Fi on board United
®
operated flights and on Club premium drinks when you pay with your United℠ Explorer Card.
Up to $120 Global Entry, TSA PreCheck
®
or NEXUS fee credit
Receive a statement credit of up to $120 every four years as reimbursement for the application fee for Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS when charged to your card.
Up to $100 in United
®
Hotels credit
Receive $50 back as a statement credit on both your 1st and 2nd prepaid hotel stays purchased directly through United
®
Hotels with your United℠ Explorer Card, up to $100 each anniversary year.
Up to $60 in credits on rideshare purchases
Enroll to receive up to $5 back as a statement credit each month on rideshare purchases when you pay with your United℠ Explorer Card, up to $60 each calendar year. Enrollment required.
Up to $50 in United travel credits on Avis or Budget car rental purchases
Receive $25 in United
®
TravelBank cash, up to $50 each anniversary year, for your 1st and 2nd Avis or Budget car rental booked directly through
cars.united.com
Opens overlay
and paid for with your United℠ Explorer Card.
,
Up to $100 in credit on JSX purchases
Get up to $100 back as a statement credit each anniversary year when you book flights directly with JSX using your United℠ Explorer Card. JSX is a hop-on jet service that offers a semi-private flying experience at commercial fares. To learn more, visit
united.com/JSX
Opens overlay
.
No foreign transaction fees
Purchases made with your United Explorer℠ Card outside the U.S. will not be subject to foreign transaction fees. For example, if you spend $5,000 internationally, you would avoid $150 in foreign transaction fees.
Priority boarding
The primary Cardmember and companions on the same reservation will be invited to board United
®
operated flights prior to general boarding. To receive priority boarding, include your MileagePlus account number when making your reservation and refer to your United boarding pass for your boarding group number.
3-Month Complimentary Instacart+ Membership
Get complimentary Instacart+ Membership for three months, including unlimited deliveries with $0 delivery fees on eligible orders. After that, you're automatically enrolled in Instacart+ at 25% off the annual rate. Service fees and Terms apply. Benefits end 12/31/27.
Up to $120 in Instacart credits
Receive a $10 Instacart credit monthly, up to $120 total each calendar year, for purchases made directly through Instacart with your United℠ Explorer Card. Terms apply. Benefits end 12/31/27.
Cardmember award pricing
You receive access to Cardmember pricing on eligible award flights when you're signed into your MileagePlus
®
account.
General members save 10% or more and Premier members save 15% or more on flights booked with miles including expanded access to Saver Award availability in United Economy
®
, United Business
®
, United Polaris
®
business class and United First
®
on two-cabin aircraft.
Concierge services
Need help finding a great new restaurant or tickets to the theater? Count on the United Explorer Card concierge services to give you personalized assistance with reservations, referrals and recommendations — anywhere in the world. Call United Explorer Card concierge services at
1-800-888-8756
for assistance.
Travel Protection
United℠ Explorer Cardmembers enjoy built-in travel protection benefits that give you peace of mind while traveling near and far.
You can find the most up to date benefits information on Chase.com. Simply log in to Chase.com, click on the “MORE” drop down menu and select “CARD BENEFITS.”
Baggage Delay Insurance
Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases like toiletries and clothing when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.
Lost Luggage Reimbursement
Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for the cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen during a covered trip.
,
Trip Delay Reimbursement
If your common carrier travel is delayed more than 12 hours or requires an overnight stay, you are covered for unreimbursed expenses, such as meals and lodging, up to $500 per covered traveler.
Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
You can be reimbursed up to $1,500 per covered traveler and $6,000 per trip for your pre-paid, non-refundable passenger fares, if your trip is canceled or cut short by sickness, severe weather or other covered situations.
Travel Accident Insurance
When you pay for your air, bus, train or cruise transportation with your card, you are eligible to receive up to $500,000 in accidental death or dismemberment coverage.
Auto Rental Coverage
Decline the rental company’s collision insurance and charge the entire rental cost to your card. Coverage is primary and provides reimbursement up to $60,000 for theft and collision damage for most rental vehicles with an MSRP of $125,000 or less.
,
For assistance with all United Explorer Card protection benefits, please call
1-800-350-2919
or
1-214-503-2953
. International charges may apply; please contact your service provider for additional details.
Purchase Protection
Shop confidently knowing that your purchases are protected by a suite of built-in benefits when you use your United Explorer Card.
You can find the most up to date benefits information on Chase.com. Simply log in to Chase.com, click on the “MORE” drop down menu and select “CARD BENEFITS."
Purchase Protection
Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $10,000 per item.
,
Extended Warranty Protection
Extends the time period of the manufacturer’s U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from the date of purchase.
For assistance with all United Explorer Card protection benefits, please call
1-800-350-2919
or
1-214-503-2953
. International charges may apply; please contact your service provider for additional details.
Fraud Protection
Free yourself from worry with exceptional Fraud Protection benefits that come with your United℠ Explorer Card.
Zero Liability Protection
Zero Liability Protection means you won’t be held responsible for unauthorized charges made with your card or account information.
Charge disputes
If you were charged in error, we will freeze that charge while we investigate your dispute.
Fraud alerts
We monitor for fraud 24/7 and can text, email or call you if there are unusual purchases on your credit card.
Dedicated Cardmember service
Whenever you call, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, you’ll be greeted by a dedicated Customer Service specialist. From disputing a strange charge to getting details on your United Quest Card benefits, a specialist is ready to assist.
Simply call
1-800-888-8756
or
1-804-673-1691
for assistance. International charges may apply; please contact your service provider for additional details.
Payment options
In addition to paying by mail, you can pay online from the
Manage your account
page, or by calling
1-800-888-8756
.

MileagePlus Program Terms and Conditions:
Miles accrued, awards, and benefits issued are subject to change and are subject to the rules of the United MileagePlus
®

®

United and its subsidiaries, affiliates and agents are not responsible for any products or services of other participating companies and partners. Taxes and fees related to award travel are the responsibility of the member. Bonus award miles, award miles and any other miles earned through non-flight activity do not count toward qualification for Premier status unless expressly stated otherwise. The accumulation of mileage or Premier status or any other status does not entitle members to any vested rights with respect to the MileagePlus Program. All calculations made in connection with the MileagePlus Program, including without limitation with respect to the accumulation of mileage and the satisfaction of the qualification requirements for Premier status, will be made by United Airlines
®
